title: Design System: CSMS Alerts — Incumbent Extension

components.name: Secondary incident action
components.description: Ordinary incident actions with inherited focus and disabled feedback.
components.css: .ds-alert-action { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: #244e60; background: #eaf2f5; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-alert-action:hover { background: #dce9ee; } .ds-alert-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2688c1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-alert-action:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 800px) { .ds-alert-action { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Close reason field
components.description: Native labelled reason for explicit incident closure.

rules.name: The State Has a Name Rule
rules.body: Pair incident identity with textual status and delivery context; preserve explicit unavailable, empty and stale-data messages.

rules.name: The Context Travels Rule
rules.body: Keep charge-point identity, station, incident state and update context available while rows and controls wrap.

rules.name: The Authority Stays Visible Rule
rules.body: Omit unavailable role actions, and keep permitted controls tied to incident state. Do not treat hidden controls as an authorization substitute.

narrative.overview:
This is a local record of the shared incident triage panel implemented in `AlertsPanel.tsx` and `alerts.css`. It extends the incumbent teal operating interface with a white container, quiet secondary actions and factual Vietnamese labels. The project-root owner design remains authoritative for its shell; this file governs only the alerts feature.

The panel inherits each host's typography and preserves existing monitoring beneath it. Operational facts, delivery state and recovery context take precedence over decoration. Owner presentation is read-only; operator and administrator actions follow the displayed incident state and role.
donts: **Don't** promote local container geometry, polling intervals or list heights into global design tokens.
**Don't** expose mutation controls in the read-only owner view.
**Don't** clear retained facts on refresh failure or imply that alerts replace live charge-point status.
**Don't** invent severity chips, navigation, imagery or a new brand palette for this extension.
dos: **Do** keep this extension inside the alerts feature and retain the host workspace's font and layout.
**Do** preserve textual incident and email states, recovery context and update timestamps.
**Do** retain explicit stale-data errors, separate action feedback and native keyboard focus.
**Do** wrap long identifiers and action groups within the bounded incident list.
keyCharacteristics: Incumbent teal ink and pale secondary actions.
Explicit incident, email and update context.
Wrapped rows and a bounded scrolling list.
Native labelled controls with visible keyboard focus.
